text:
Type: slim aluminium floor reading lamp
Use: reading light beside a sofa, an armchair or a bed; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: minimalist, industrial, Scandinavian
Materials: brushed aluminium shade, pole and base, black cord with inline switch
Colors: brushed silver, black
Shape: thin straight pole with a curved neck holding a small cone shade, adjustable head, round flat base, tall and very slender, light visual weight
Feel: simple, practical, airy, functional
Goes with: grey or white sofas, light wood, metal accents; minimalist, Scandinavian or industrial rooms

product.name: LERSTA
product.description: You can easily direct the light where you want it because the lamp arm is adjustable.
